thread:
Marta: Quick sync — locking acceptance criteria for Private Deploy (VPC control plane + on‑prem packaging + air‑gapped flow). Need decisions on network requirements, installer constraints, and customer handoff checklist. Can owners ack?
Ken: Ack. I'll own control plane network requirements. Quick Q: do we require cross-account ENI or prefer customer-managed NAT?
Aj: Prefer customer-managed NAT for security; optional cross-account peering is ok for large enterprises.
Sara: Packaging lead here. Packaging constraints: signed images + offline bundle + single installer binary. For airgap we need sha256 manifest and simple registry load instructions.
Marta: Draft minimal acceptance (MVP):
- Control plane reachable only via customer VPC peering or PrivateLink
- Control plane uses customer-managed KMS for secrets (no shared keys)
- Installer must run from tarball + image bundle with zero outbound dependency
- E2E smoke: load small model, run 1 qps inference, and export metrics to local Prometheus endpoint
Ken: +1. Add network port matrix and recommended CIDR ranges. I'll put together an RFC by EOD Friday.
Aj: One more: fallback routing to hosted (higher-cost tier) when local capacity exhausted — in-scope for later, yes?
Marta: Not for initial MVP. Document as future work.
Sara: For airgap validation I need two pilot customers plus an infra test harness. Who can sponsor customer pilots? @Ken?
Ken: I can sponsor two pilot customers from the sales pilot list; will sync with Sales.
Marta: Owners assigned: Ken (control plane + network), Sara (packaging + airgap), Aj (security + policy). Deliverables: RFCs, installer tarball + manifest, acceptance checklist, and test harness. Target: EoQ.
Aj: Security note: mTLS required between control plane and node agents; installer will bootstrap a CA and rotate certs via customer KMS where available.
Sara: Packaging example for airgap load:
```
# load images into local registry
ctr -n k8s.io images import images.tar
# run offline installer
./redwood-private-installer --offline --manifest=manifest.yaml
```
Ken: Risk: Some customers block outbound DNS. Installer must support IP-only manifests or an /etc/hosts fallback.
Marta: Add to acceptance: installer can complete with no DNS resolution required.
deploy-bot: Deploy job redwood/private/installer-nightly started (build 189).
Sara: I'll attach sha256 manifest and public key location to the RFC draft.
Marta: Next sync Thu 10am PT. If no objections I'll convert this thread into the PRD checklist. :thumbsup:
